This '''mercenary''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was hired by [[Darth Nyriss]] to follow a lead pertaining to the [[Assassination attempts on Darth Nyriss|attacks on her life]] and to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]. She and her [[Unidentified male mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|partner]] was [[Death/Legends|slaughtered]] outside [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold]] when they [[Skirmish outside of Darth Nyriss's stronghold|attempted]] to assassinate Lord Scourge.

==Biography==
In [[3954 BBY]], a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] was hired by [[Darth Nyriss]] to follow a lead pertaining to the [[Assassination attempts on Darth Nyriss|attacks on her life]] and to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]. She and her [[Unidentified male mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|partner]] arrived at [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold]] in a [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] firing the auto-targeting [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] at the Sith Lord, who took shelter behind the [[Statue of the Sith Emperor|statue]] of the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]]. After seeing that they were turning around to make another pass, Scourge [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber throw|threw]] his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the speeder clipping the back end. They abandoned the speeder, after beheading the statue of the Emperor and crash landing. She drew her [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and attempted to defend her partner, while attempted to free his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] of the wreckage.<ref name="Revan" />

Scourge [[Force jump/Legends|leapt]] over the speeder and [[Death/Legends|slew]] the male mercenary before he could bring his weapon to bear. She unloaded another series of shots at Scourge, even wounding him with one shot, as her partner went down. In response Scourge [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force push|Force pushed]] her into one of Nyriss's statues, the impact jarring her blaster from her hands, and leaving her defenseless for a few moments. As Scourge vaulted over the crashed speeder and raced to he position, she pulled out her short [[electrorod]] as she dropped into a fighting crouch. After circling each other Scourge offered her the chance to live and to work with him if she named who hired her to kill him. She hesitated for a second as she debated whether to tell him or not, when Nyriss's security chief [[Murtog]] and several [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] exited the stronghold and [[Death/Legends|shot her]] multiple times.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The female mercenary first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
